tool.name: Claude 3 Opus
tool.summary: Anthropic's most powerful model for complex analysis, long documents, and nuanced reasoning tasks requiring deep comprehension.

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
message = client.messages.create(
  model="claude-3-opus-20240229",
  max_tokens=2048,
  messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this research paper."}]
